tldr: The Sun through the 2nd house brings attention to money, security, values, and self-worth.
body:
When the Sun moves through your 2nd house, it brings attention to money, security, possessions, self-worth, spending, income, and what helps you feel steady. You may notice what feels worth keeping, what costs too much, and what would help life feel more stable.

Something may feel more visible, energizing, exposed, or ready to be claimed. It can help you notice what needs more life, honesty, or direct attention.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for making a more honest choice around resources, desire, and value.

The caution: Watch for needing validation so badly that you miss what actually feels true. The risk is confusing immediate comfort with real security.

The Sun moves through this house for about a month. Use the visibility well. Put attention where it gives you more life, not just more approval.
